hyena: An adult spotted hyena standing in full side profile, head turned toward the viewer. Build: HEAVY AND TOP-HEAVY, with massive muscular shoulders and long thick front legs, the back SLOPING DOWN toward noticeably lower, shorter hindquarters with slightly bent hocks. Neck THICK AND DEEP, as wide as the head. Coat: COARSE, SHAGGY AND SLIGHTLY SCRUFFY rather than sleek, sandy buff to pale ginger, covered in DARK BROWN IRREGULAR SPOTS that are densest across the back, flanks and haunches and fade out on the neck. The hair along the top of the neck and shoulders is LONGER AND DARKER, forming a low shaggy mane lying along the spine - a ridge of untidy hair, not a tall upright crest. Head: THE HEAD AND FACE ARE DISTINCTLY DARKER THAN THE BODY, a greyish-brown, with a BLUNT BLACK MUZZLE. EARS ARE LARGE, TALL AND ROUNDED AT THE TIPS like a bear's, held upright and facing forward - big rounded ears, never small and never pointed. Mouth CLOSED with no teeth showing, calm and watchful. Short bushy tail with a dark tip.
